en: A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) aerial view of a European town with dense, traditional gabled houses and shops around a central street. In the foreground are multi‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; signage on the façades advertises restaurants and shops. Further back stand additional townhouses, a larger institutional building, factory chimneys, and open countryside beyond the town. The lower margin of the image contains printed publisher information at the left and the red caption "Eilenburg." in the center.
